reference_cohort_info_part.model_build_note: This study used pre-trained BrainCharts GAMLSS normative models from Bethlehem et al. 2022 (reference 98), trained on 75,241 TD individuals from 100 studies. The reference cohort was not constructed within this paper. Per the extraction guide, RCI-1 through RCI-7 extraction is not required for Pre-trained studies.

rci1_using_msad.detail: Not applicable. Normative models were pre-trained in Bethlehem et al. 2022 (BrainCharts). The reference cohort of 75,241 TD individuals was assembled in the original BrainCharts study, not in this paper.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Here, we leveraged models of average brain development previously characterized by our group (98)" / "Our previous work (98) generated reference models using generalized additive models of location scale and shape to map neuroanatomical developmental trajectories across the life span, using a sample of 75,241 TD individuals"
rci1_using_msad.location: Bedford2025.pdf.md: Methods / Generation of Centile Scores Using GAMLSS, L53-L61

rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Out-of-sample centile scores for our study sample were generated based on these reference models using Brent's maximum likelihood estimation"
